texts.preamble: M/S. Albanit And Co. Through Its Prop vs Union Territory Of J&K And Others on 3 June, 2024 Author: Sanjeev Kumar Bench: Sanjeev Kumar Serial No. 142 Regular List High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh At Srinagar Wp(C) No. 650/2023 Cm No. 1537/2023 Cm No. 4566/2023 M/S. Albanit and Co. through its Prop. ...Applicant(s)/Petitioner(s) Through: Mr.Adil Asimi, Adv. Vs. Union Territory of J&K and Others ...Respondent(s) Through: Mr. Furqan Wani, Ga. Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Kumar, Judge. Order 03.06.2024 01.
texts.facts: In this petition, the petitioner has called in question e-Tender notice bearing No. SKIMS MC 08 of 2023 dated 3rd March, 2023 issued by the respondent No. 4.
texts.arguments: The petitioner seeks a direction to the respondents to necessarily incorporate the specific terms and conditions/guidelines contained under the Food, Safety and Standards Authority of India Act, 2006, ('FSSAI Act, 2006') and the rules and regulations framed thereunder. 02. Learned counsel for the respondent-SKIMS states at bar that in view of the expiry of validity of e-Tenders, the respondents have decided to issue fresh e-Tender notice for the work in question.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The petitioner seeks a direction to the respondents to necessarily incorporate the specific terms and conditions/guidelines contained under the Food, Safety and Standards Authority of India Act, 2006, ('FSSAI Act, 2006') and the rules and regulations framed thereunder. 02. Learned counsel for the respondent-SKIMS states at bar that in view of the expiry of validity of e-Tenders, the respondents have decided to issue fresh e-Tender notice for the work in question.
